text.p: These are the headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- First Winnipeggers flee homes: Officials letting part of flood pass through city rather than put rural residents at risk.
- Huge project set for air base: Downsview to get C$1.4 billion in houses, factories.
- Red River Valley a desperate scene: Highway disappears into new lake, some dikes have collapsed, worst is to come.
- Peace broker sells guns: South Africa supplies Ugandans.
- Manning content to finish second: Reform plans campaign to oust Bloc.
- Chretien launches appeal to Quebec: 'Real power' resides with Liberals.
- Church urges Catholics to accept gays: Vatican article says that chastity is vital for homosexuals to gain sanctity.
- Huge Toronto complex okayed: Reichmanns part of consortium involved in C$1.4-billion urban restoration project.
- Bell to build giant Canadian R&D lab: Hundreds of high-tech jobs expected.
- Pattison bids to take Great Pacific private: Investors applaud as shares soar C$14.25.
- Noranda spending to reach C$2.2-billion: Capital funds to focus on profitability.
- Bre-X brokers under fire: Shareholders say tapes could prove top Bay Street advisers misled investors.
